description: A set of radio buttons built on Radix UI RadioGroup. Implements the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern with roving tabindex — only the selected (or first) radio item is in the tab order. Arrow keys navigate between items within the group.

keyboard.action: Moves focus and selection to the next radio item
Moves focus and selection to the next radio item
Moves focus and selection to the previous radio item
Moves focus and selection to the previous radio item
Moves focus into the radio group (to the selected item) or out of the group
Selects the focused radio item if not already selected

focus.notes: Uses roving tabindex so only the selected radio item is in the tab order. Arrow keys move both focus and selection. Focus ring is visible on the currently focused radio item.

announcements: Each radio item announces its label, checked state, and position (e.g. "1 of 3")
The radio group label is announced via aria-labelledby or aria-label on the group
screenReader.notes: Radix RadioGroup manages aria-checked on each item and sets the appropriate radiogroup role on the container.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for label text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for radio circle border and selected indicator)

consumerResponsibilities: Provide a group label using aria-label or aria-labelledby on the RadioGroup root
Pair each RadioGroupItem with a visible Label using htmlFor
Ensure all radio items have distinct, descriptive labels
Use a fieldset and legend pattern if semantic grouping is important
